data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 新宿雨夜·霓虹街角与傲娇侧影
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 新宿雨夜·霓虹街角与傲娇侧影】被淅沥冷雨浇湿的新宿街头，闪烁的霓虹灯倒映在积水之中。换上帅气黑色皮夹克与短裙的黑贞单手插兜倚靠在墙角，金色眼眸斜睨着你，别扭地轻哼一声——「别自作多情了！我只是顺路经过这里而已……喂，你那把伞太小了，还不快点靠过来一点！」
data.promptProse: At the wet Shinjuku corner, Jeanne Alter leans against the wall with one hand in her jacket pocket and the other relaxed beside her black pleated skirt. Leather jacket, tank top, dark tights and boots retain the street outfit. She turns reluctantly toward the viewer in the medium view, rain trailing along the wall. Cyan and magenta shop light catches silver hair and eyes, spreading broken reflections across the pavement.
data.action: 穿黑夹克短裙靠在街角墙边，一手插兜，侧头望向同行者
